'''2007 California State Championship Steve Jones LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Jones]] at [[2007 California State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Tight Like That
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
